facts.P1_fx_receipts: Yes, freely; exchange control was suspended in 1994.
facts.P2_fcy_account: Very likely, with no exchange control; not confirmed.
facts.P3_local_gateways: Local gateways not confirmed yet; see the services listed above.
facts.L1_registration: Register with the CBRD for a Business Registration Number, then with the MRA.
facts.L2_tax_id: TAN (Tax Account Number) from the Mauritius Revenue Authority.
facts.L3_income_tax_foreign: Mauritius-derived income and remitted foreign income taxed at 0–20%.
facts.L4_vat_gst: 15% VAT above MUR 3 million; consultants must register regardless of turnover.
facts.L5_data_protection: Data Protection Act 2017: register with the Data Protection Office.
facts.L6_consumer_ecommerce: Online consumer protection law exists; refund rules not confirmed yet.

watch_out.text: Freelance consultants may have to register for VAT from the first rupee.
Processing personal data without registering is an offence.
